articles.title: Les Etats-Unis retirent leurs bombardiers de la base britannique près de laquelle a eu lieu un incident

articles.title: Yemen military announces broad range of strikes against Houthis in bid to retake lost territory
articles.description: The Yemeni military announced on Monday that it will launch a broad set of strikes against Iran-backed Houthi targets in an attempt to retake lost territory. The Houthis launched an offensive in September, which killed hundreds of combatants on both sides, according to UN figures, and has since become the most active front in the wider Middle East war.

articles.description: Family members of former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro won big in Sunday's general election, including the right-wing lawmaker's eldest son Flavio Bolsonaro, who surpassed President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva in the first-round presidential vote.
